security_rule: No exposed instructional finished prompt reuse. Secure family variants preserve evidence/structure/difficulty while visibly changing a declared semantic stimulus axis.
answer_position_rule: For selected-response instances, deterministic answer-position scrambling occurs downstream after content is fixed and independently verified.
